Returns 503 PROVIDER (same init 404 path), so legacy upload/rename/delete regression cannot complete.

After backend fix, rerun /app/tests/api/test_cloud_sharing_iter51.py to validate binary integrity, idempotency, soft-delete republish, and member/nonmember permissions end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: Cloud store currently hardcodes objstore path append on top of INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL; with '/llm' base this breaks provider init at runtime.
cloud-store has env fallbacks (AI_DIR and integration URL defaults), which can mask misconfiguration and diverges from strict fail-fast env policy.
Potential policy gap: /ai-api/cloud is not included in FEATURE_BY_PREFIX in proxy.ts despite requirement to preserve cloud gating behavior.

rca of the issue: Repro: POST /ai-api/cloud/share or /ai-api/cloud/upload as admin with valid payload -> 503 PROVIDER and message 'init 404'. Backend env has INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL ending with '/llm'. cloud-store builds STORAGE_URL as `${INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL}/objstore/api/v1/storage`, resulting in '/llm/objstore/.../init' which returns 404. Because all share/upload paths depend on initStorage(), backend cloud copy creation is blocked and downstream UI/integration validations fail.
